questions.question: What is the published monthly fee for the Aurora account?

criteria.factHint: states EUR 6 as the published Aurora monthly fee

runs.answer: The published Aurora monthly fee is EUR 6. It is waived to EUR 0 only if, in the same month, you receive a salary payment of at least EUR 1,200 and make three settled card purchases; if either condition is missing, the fee is EUR 6. [aurora-conditions-2026 v2]

questions.question: Will I be charged a fee for my Aurora account this month?

criteria.factHint: states EUR 0 / that the waiver applies for this month
criteria.forbiddenHint: does NOT state that this customer will be charged EUR 6

runs.answer:
Your Aurora account’s September 2026 fee is **EUR 0**; both waiver conditions were met:

- Salary of at least EUR 1,200: **Met** — a September salary payment of EUR 1,750.
- At least three settled card purchases: **Met** — four card-like purchases were recorded.

The Aurora fee is waived when both conditions are met [aurora-fees-2026 v2].

**Caveats:** Posted movements are treated as settled because the ledger does not record settlement status. Movements are counted by their September posting date, so postings near a month boundary may fall in an adjacent month.
